summary: Resume OMP seats by the checked transcript path so st-staged transcript symlinks are found (st2#3021)

replay.detail: st resumes an OMP seat by `omp --resume <transcript path>`, the path st already checked, instead of `omp --resume <session ID>`. The session-ID lookup in OMP does not follow the symlink st stages in provider-sessions. The header-ID check, strict-resume refusal and native binding check are unchanged. Internal launch argument only: no contract, storage, replay, rules or protocol change.
